page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.4xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. The system is equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 32.0 GB, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of exactly 2.0 GB per vCPU core.

This instance configuration features no bundled local disk storage and contains no discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Storage requirements must be satisfied via external network-attached block volumes. Network communication is backed by a 12 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

By maintaining a compute-focused ratio of processing power to RAM without attached local storage, the instance minimizes unused resource overhead for workloads that do not require high memory capacity. The ecs.c8i.4xlarge is structured for compute-heavy applications such as web serving, continuous integration and build pipelines, batch data processing, and application backend operations.
